people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

people.name: Telaim
people.line: Place where Saul gathered his army

translations.web: Saul summoned the people, and counted them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.
translations.bsb: So Saul summoned the troops and numbered them at Telaim—200,000 foot soldiers and 10,000 men of Judah.
translations.kjv: And Saul gathered ➔ the people together, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.
translations.asv: And Saul summoned the people, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.
